name: ghostcommit
description: Semantic intent and hallucination auditor for AI diff-bombs: flags off-spec edits, deleted error handling, phantom imports and more, with a 3-line Diff Risk Score.

interface.shortDescription: Audit AI-generated diffs for off-spec edits and silent regressions.
interface.longDescription: Compares your staged or uncommitted changes against the task you asked for. Flags unrelated files and helpers, deleted try/catch and guard clauses, dropped types, hardcoded secrets, hallucinated imports, truncation placeholders and weakened tests, then prints a 3-line summary with a color-coded Diff Risk Score. Report only: it never edits your code.
defaultPrompt: Audit my uncommitted changes against what I just asked for
Review my staged diff for silent regressions before I commit
